text:
Maya: Heads-up — we need a new GPU node pool in eu-west6 (Zurich) for low-latency inference traffic. Two immediate blockers: egress IP constraints for customer allowlists, and cluster-autoscaler surge/safety for mixed preemptible pool. Thoughts?

Jon: +1 for eu-west6, latency looks good. Question: A10G for emb/low-cost or H100 for perf-critical?

Maya: Prefer A10G as primary — most traffic is embeddings and batching. We'll keep a small H100 pool for heavy models that can't be quantized.

Alesha: Region quota FYI — eu-west6 has low GPU quota right now. Please file a quota request asap (GCP). I can sponsor the request. Example: open a support ticket and request "A100/A10G GPU quota increase".

Ravi: Also watch egress limits — our current NAT gateway setup in that region only has 2 static IPs, customers with allowlists will fail if nodes scale and SNAT rotates. Recommend either: 1) reserve a pool of static IPs (NAT gateway) and map, or 2) use egress IP per node via Cloud NAT + dedicated prefix.

Kevin: Autoscaler notes — mixing preemptible and non-preemptible needs surge protection to avoid mass evictions + scale-down oscillation. Recommend these defaults: maxSurge: 20%, maxUnavailable: 10%, scaleDownDelay: 15m. Example autoscaler config:```yaml
apiVersion: cluster.k8s.io/v1
kind: MachineDeployment
spec:
  replicas: 0 # controlled by CA
  strategy:
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 20%
      maxUnavailable: 10%
  autoscaling:
    minReplicas: 0
    maxReplicas: 60
    gpuTypes: ["a10g"]
```

Maya: Good call. For egress, can we map 8 static IPs to start? That should cover burst + some customers.

Ravi: 8 should be fine initially but request for a floating prefix is safer long-term (less firewall churn). Also: set kubelet eviction thresholds for GPU pods so memory pressure doesn't kill pods mid-inference.

Jon: Taints/affinity plan: taint node: "gpu=true:NoSchedule" and use tolerations on inference workloads. Add PodDisruptionBudget for critical replicaset >=2:```yaml
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
spec:
  minAvailable: 1
```

Alesha: Cost ballpark: A10G ~ $0.95/hr (preemptible ~ $0.28), H100 ~ $6.5/hr. If we target 50 A10G-equivalent nodes steady at 60% utilization -> ~ $34k/mo preemptible mix; 10 H100 steady would be ~ $47k/mo. Need finance signoff for committed capacity.

Infra Oncall: Ops note — set scaleDownUtilizationThreshold to 0.45 to avoid scaling down during short lulls. Also add autoscaler "cooldownPeriod" to 10m. Update runbook: fallback route -> route traffic to hosted inference tier if eu-west6 capacity < 5 nodes.

Maya: Action items: Alesha file quota request (assign to @Alesha), Ravi propose egress IP plan + firewall checklist, Jon draft terraform node pool module with taints/labels, Kevin update autoscaler defaults. I'll draft runbook changes and cost ask.

Jon: I'll start the terraform module and include nodepool metadata + autoscaler variables. Link will be in PR later today.

deploy-bot: quota-request created: Q-98321 (eu-west6 GPU quota + NAT IPs). Alesha assigned.

Alesha: Filed support ticket with cloud — added throughput justification and customer list. ETA 48-72h. :thumbsup:

Maya: Great. If quota looks good, we'll do a controlled rollout (canary 2 nodes, then 8, then full). Will post rollout timeline here.

Kevin: Suggest adding a lightweight canary latency test (10 qps) against the pool and a DSCP tag for inference traffic so network vendors can prioritize — we already have tooling to validate DSCP markings.

Ravi: Agreed on DSCP; add validation step in CI: send marked packets and assert egress IP stability.

Maya: Perfect. Thanks all — will update once quota is approved.
